notes: Completes coverage with core enforcement logic and comprehensive testing layer.

stories.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
stories.description: Implement the server-side enforcement engine that evaluates incoming GPTReader requests against the defined allowlist schema, including collection access, field-level filtering, operator restrictions, and query limits before execution.

stories.title: Secure API Wrapper for GPTReader Requests
stories.description: Wrap GPTReader endpoints with a secure API layer that enforces validation before any database interaction, ensuring all inbound requests pass through the allowlist enforcement engine and rejection handling pipeline.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Test Suite for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering valid requests, blocked queries, edge cases (field injection, operator misuse, over-limit queries), and regression scenarios to ensure enforcement reliability.

per_feature.mitigation: Strict pre-execution validation and deny-by-default logic enforced in a single entry point.
